title: juphyter
tagline: A Jupyter and Quarto kernel for PHP.
summary: Run PHP in Jupyter notebooks and Quarto documents, with tables and charts displayed alongside code.
One PHP session lasts across cells. phibble data frames appear as tables and phiz plots as charts, and a notebook inside a Composer project can use that project's classes.

optional.name: pcntl PHP extension
optional.for: interrupting a running cell with the stop button

optional.name: vl-convert
optional.for: static phiz plot images in PDF and Word output

optional.name: phibble, phplyr, and phiz
optional.for: data frame tables and charts in notebooks

verify.note: Checks kernel readiness and optional Quarto support.

examples.title: Show a table and a chart in a notebook
examples.description: Reads mtcars by URL in a JupyterLab notebook, summarizes fuel economy by cylinder count, and plots it against weight.

nav.title: Show a table and a chart in a notebook

evidence_gaps.benchmarks: No benchmark covers Quarto render time, which Quarto and Pandoc dominate, or a cell that streams large output.
evidence_gaps.verification: Not checked: inspect, history, and stdin requests, comms and widgets, and the debugger, which juphyter does not implement; JupyterLab's own rendering of outputs; and Linux on arm64.
